# 分册登记簿：四站「现场预约」分册

# 形式: 核给/留位/顺位；额度与优先号按三种措辞解析
import re, io, csv

raw = {}
import glob
for path in sorted(glob.glob("inbox/06-02/*联席纪要.txt")):
    txt=open(path,encoding="utf-8").read()
    station=re.search(r"(\S+?)联席纪要", txt).group(1)
    # split by 议案
    blocks=re.split(r"\n(?=议案 )", txt)
    for b in blocks:
        m=re.match(r"议案\s+(\d+)\s+客户\s+(J\d+)", b)
        if not m: continue
        yian, case = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        clauses={}
        for line in b.splitlines():
            cm=re.match(r"(\S+册)｜(.*)", line.strip())
            if not cm: continue
            book, body = cm.group(1), cm.group(2)
            status = "正本" if ("正本" in body and "草案" not in body) else ("草案" if "草案" in body else "?")
            # period
            per=re.search(r"六月(\d+)日至(\d+)日", body)
            start=int(per.group(1)); end=int(per.group(2))
            # parse amounts
            quota=None; prio=None
            m1=re.search(r"核给(\d+)席.*?优先号(\d+)", body)
            m2=re.search(r"办理顺位(\d+).*?额度(\d+)席", body)
            m3=re.search(r"留位为(\d+)席.*?优先号(\d+)", body)
            if m1: quota=int(m1.group(1)); prio=int(m1.group(2)); form="核给"
            elif m2: prio=int(m2.group(1)); quota=int(m2.group(2)); form="顺位"
            elif m3: quota=int(m3.group(1)); prio=int(m3.group(2)); form="留位"
            else: form="?"
            clauses[book]=(form,quota,prio,start,end,status)
        raw[(station,yian)]=(case,clauses)

# Build per-case candidate from ONSITE booklet only
from collections import defaultdict
cand=defaultdict(list)  # case -> list of (yian, quota, prio, status, start,end, form, station, book)
for (station,yian),(case,clauses) in raw.items():
    book=onsite[station]
    c=clauses.get(book)
    assert c, (station,yian,book,clauses)
    form,quota,prio,start,end,status=c
    cand[case].append((int(yian),quota,prio,status,start,end,form,station,book))

for case in sorted(cand):
    print(case, "站=",cand[case][0][7], "现场册=",cand[case][0][8])
    for it in sorted(cand[case]):
        print("   议案",it[0],it[6],"额度",it[1],"优先",it[2],it[3],f"{it[4]}-{it[5]}")
